item.title: Exclusive: Ozarks First documentary uncovers new details in Cassidy Rainwater case

item.title: Last week’s Springfield restaurant health code violations, Mar. 16-20
item.description: Health code violations were observed in 28 restaurants in Springfield, MO last week, with 1 priority violation found in 7 BREW COFFEE and 1 in ASH GROVE ELEMENTARY SCHOOL, and 1 nonpriority violation found in ALDI FOOD STORE #67 and AMERICAN LEGION POST #639.

item.title: No-excuse absentee voting for April elections begins in Greene County
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. -- Registered voters in Greene County can now vote absentee in person for the municipal election on Tuesday, April 7. Greene County Clerk Shane Schoeller says no-excuse absentee voting begins Tuesday, March 24, and will be available at the Greene County Archives on 1126 N. Boonville Ave. in Springfield. item.title: Springfield shooting: Bullet holes found in Locust Street home
item.description: Police are investigating a reported shooting in Springfield involving shots fired, with no injuries reported and no additional information released.

item.title: Howell County Sheriff’s office seizes nearly one pound of meth in West Plains
item.description: A three-month narcotics investigation led to the arrest of a West Plains man and the seizure of nearly a pound of methamphetamine, as well as other drug paraphernalia, during a search warrant operation Tuesday.

item.title: Vinyl Vault chases waterfalls with TLC's CrazySexyCool
item.description: In this episode of The Vinyl Vault, Ozarks First's Parker Padgett and Tony Nguyen explore the iconic album "CrazySexyCool" by TLC, discussing how the group evolved from their new jack swing roots into global superstars and highlighting timeless hits like "Waterfalls", "Creep", and "Red Light Special".
